results.name: IAT-04 lifecycle
results.proves: the real coordinator drives the real worker with a synthetic MediaStream: start converges to Receiving, stop converges to Stopped with cleanupComplete, and a stream authorized after stop has its tracks stopped immediately

results.name: IAT-05 video import
results.detail: codec=video/webm;codecs=vp9 file=1546417B state=Ready artifactBytes=7538 expected=7538 sha256=a0310e43fc6560dd6701fcb474d89244a0ce8b3730fb06dbd35e2566b250c3e5 matchesWasm=true
results.proves: a REAL MediaRecorder-encoded WebM/VP9 recording rebuilds an artifact whose SHA-256 is byte-identical to the artifact from the direct-frame path (IAT-01) - two independent paths agree on every byte of the 7538-byte file. This is the real-recording-format evidence the handoff requires (WebM/VP8 class); MP4/H.264 stays on the support matrix for the field round.

notes: The recording runs at 50 Mbps to isolate pipeline correctness from codec loss; realistic-bitrate behavior is measured in T4.2.
VideoSource handles the MediaRecorder unknown-duration header by forcing duration calculation before the precheck.
